name: Medical Wagon
speed: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 1 Large creature)

items.name: Enhanced Medicinal Tools
items.text: When attempting a Medicine check inside a medical wagon, you gain a +2 item bonus.

text: Medical wagons are frequent sights near the battlefield. These wagons carry various mundane and magical medical supplies and are generally staffed by a medic. A small gurney is mounted in the back of the wagon for transporting personnel or for use as an emergency operating table.
